items.title: Boring History for Sleep: Winter in a Viking Longhouse (Snow & Fireplace, 46 Min)
items.description:
Spend a long, snowy winter evening inside a Viking longhouse at the head of a Norwegian fjord, about a thousand years ago. Sit by the long hearth, listen to the animals settling in the byre, share a simple supper, watch the spinning and weaving, a slow game of tafl, and the old Norse stories of Night and her frost-maned horse. Softly narrated, with snowfall, firelight and a long, restful ending.
